Name: pwsh.exe
CommandLine:
"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repo = 'D:\DEV\role-model\.worktrees\62-litellm-pi-craft-codex-execution-hardening'
$liveDir = Join-Path $repo '.recursive\run\62-litellm-pi-craft-codex-execution-hardening\evidence\logs\addendum-17\live\craft-headless-combined'
$tmpRoot = Join-Path $repo '.tmp-craft-headless-addendum17-combined'
$userData = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'user-data'
$configDir = Join-Path $tmpRoot 'config'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $liveDir,$userData,$configDir | Out-Null
$currentPid = $PID
$existing = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $currentPid -and $_.CommandLine -match '\.tmp-craft-headless-addendum17-combined' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine)
$existing | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $liveDir 'processes-before-start.json') -Encoding utf8
foreach ($old in $existing) { Stop-Process -Id $old.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
$exe = 'C:\Users\erikb\AppData\Local\Programs\@craft-agentelectron\Craft Agents.exe'
$serverStdout = Join-Path $liveDir 'craft-server.stdout.log'
$serverStderr = Join-Path $liveDir 'craft-server.stderr.log'
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $serverStdout,$serverStderr -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$env:CRAFT_HEADLESS = '1'
$env:CRAFT_CONFIG_DIR = $configDir
$env:CRAFT_RPC_HOST = '127.0.0.1'
$env:CRAFT_RPC_PORT = '0'
$proc = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList @('--user-data-dir', $userData) -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $serverStdout -RedirectStandardError $serverStderr -PassThru
try {
  $url = $null
  $token = $null
  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(60)
  while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    if (Test-Path $serverStdout) {
      $content = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $serverStdout -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      if ($content -match 'CRAFT_SERVER_URL=(\S+)') { $url = $Matches[1] }
      if ($content -match 'CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN=(\S+)') { $token = $Matches[1] }
      if ($url -and $token) { break }
    }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
  }
  if (-not $url -or -not $token) { throw 'Craft headless server did not emit URL/token' }
  $env:CRAFT_SERVER_URL = $url
  $env:CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN = $token
  $env:ROLE_MODEL_ENDPOINT = 'http://127.0.0.1:3456'
  $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS = '150000'
  $script = Join-Path $repo '.recursive\run\62-litellm-pi-craft-codex-execution-hardening\evidence\scripts\craft-headless-verify.mjs'
  $cases = @(
    @{ name='craft-alias-difficulty-after-fix'; model='difficulty.remote-only'; prompt='Reply with exactly CRAFT_ADD17_ALIAS_OK.'; expected='CRAFT_ADD17_ALIAS_OK'; thinking='high' },
    @{ name='craft-exact-chatgpt-after-fix'; model='chatgpt/gpt-5.4'; prompt='Reply with exactly CRAFT_ADD17_GPT_OK.'; expected='CRAFT_ADD17_GPT_OK'; thinking='high' }
  )
  $results = @()
  foreach ($case in $cases) {
    $name = [string]$case['name']
    $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_MODEL = [string]$case['model']
    $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_PROMPT = [string]$case['prompt']
    $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_EXPECTED_TEXT = [string]$case['expected']
    $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_THINKING_LEVEL = [string]$case['thinking']
    $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_OUTPUT = Join-Path $liveDir \"$name-result.json\"
    $stdout = Join-Path $liveDir \"$name.stdout.log\"
    $stderr = Join-Path $liveDir \"$name.stderr.log\"
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stdout,$stderr,$env:CRAFT_VERIFY_OUTPUT -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $started = Get-Date
    node $script > $stdout 2> $stderr
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    $durationMs = [int]((Get-Date) - $started).TotalMilliseconds
    $output = $null
    if (Test-Path $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_OUTPUT) { $output = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_OUTPUT | ConvertFrom-Json }
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{
      name = $name
      model = $case['model']
      expected = $case['expected']
      exitCode = $exitCode
      durationMs = $durationMs
      ok = $exitCode -eq 0 -and [bool]$output.ok
      elapsedMs = $output.elapsedMs
      sessionId = $output.sessionId
      output = $env:CRAFT_VERIFY_OUTPUT
      stdout = $stdout
      stderr = $stderr
    }
  }
  [pscustomobject]@{
    generatedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
    serverPid = $proc.Id
    serverUrl = $url
    tokenPresent = [bool]$token
    roleModelEndpoint = $env:ROLE_MODEL_ENDPOINT
    results = $results
  } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $liveDir 'craft-summary-after-fix.json') -Encoding utf8
  Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $liveDir 'craft-summary-after-fix.json')
} finally {
  $matching = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $currentPid -and $_.CommandLine -match '\.tmp-craft-headless-addendum17-combined' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine)
  $matching | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $liveDir 'processes-before-stop.json') -Encoding utf8
  foreach ($child in $matching) { Stop-Process -Id $child.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
  $remaining = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '\.tmp-craft-headless-addendum17-combined' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine)
  $remaining | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $liveDir 'processes-after-stop.json') -Encoding utf8
}"
